test_title: PYST 15: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 10 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with an adverbial usage error.

frequent, / Clara fled / from the / angry dog.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. frequent .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"frequent"** is an adjective that describes nouns but is incorrectly used in an adverbial context here.
 
• In the sentence, the context requires an adverb to modify the action of fleeing, not an adjective.
 
• The correct adverbial form of "frequent" is **"frequently."**

Correct sentence: *Clara fled **frequently** from the angry dog.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Adjectives vs. Adverbs:**

 
 
• **Adjectives:** Describe or modify nouns (e.g., "angry dog").
 
• **Adverbs:** Describe or modify verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs (e.g., "Clara fled frequently").
 
 
 
• **Common Error:** Misusing adjectives in place of adverbs in sentences where actions are being described.
